overview: A multi-tenant task management platform with AI-powered task decomposition, priority scoring, and team collaboration features.

core_features.name: AI Task Decomposition
core_features.description: Automatically break down complex tasks into subtasks with estimated effort

core_features.name: Smart Priority Scoring
core_features.description: ML-based priority scoring considering deadline, dependencies, team capacity

core_features.name: Team Collaboration
core_features.description: Real-time updates, @mentions, file sharing within tasks

core_features.name: Analytics Dashboard
core_features.description: Team velocity, bottleneck detection, workload distribution charts
